provenance.population: Event-aligned action chunks from one task; not 50-task model averages.
provenance.descriptor: Current dual-arm state plus eight time-normalized knots of relative translation, relative rotation, and gripper state for both arms.
provenance.embedding: Training-only PCA fitted once to all expert and off-expert samples.

sampling.method: All source rows per category, rendered in original CSV order; no subsampling
sampling.pointRows: Zero-based CSV data rows, excluding its header

hdr.estimator: scipy.stats.gaussian_kde, Scott bandwidth multiplied by the per-category scale
hdr.threshold: Density at first descending-grid cumulative sum reaching 95% of total grid density
hdr.offExpertUnion: Pointwise maximum of the four family density/threshold scores; contour level 1
